caption:
Some days the mountain is loud. Wind on the ridge, snow moving sideways, the summit coming and going in the cloud.

We don't push on days like this. We read it, pick the sheltered side, and ski the trees below while the top sorts itself out. That's what the guide is for: knowing when to turn around, and where the good snow is hiding instead.

Next winter's small-group weeks are filling up. Send us a message if you want to talk about dates.
